evidence.detail: report() accepts a ReportForm that has no field for the MTGO lobby comment; the comment is never received or checked server-side
PDBot is identified only by api_token; no lobby-comment field exists in the form or in ReportForm.__init__
Zero hits — the decksite has no awareness of the MTGO lobby comment at report time

triage.notes: The fix requires PDBot (separate repo) to pass the MTGO match lobby comment when auto-reporting, AND the decksite /report/ endpoint to reject submissions where the comment contains 'pd practice'. Two-sided change across codebases; the decksite side alone is not sufficient.
